headline: Sierra raises $1.75 billion Series F at a $30 billion valuation
body: Sierra, the customer experience company co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round that doubles its valuation to $30 billion. The round was led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners, and its clients include BNY, HSBC, Wells Fargo and JPMorganChase, TechCrunch reports.
note: Banks appear on the client list of one of the best-funded customer service agent vendors, which shows where investor money is going in contact-center AI.

evidence.text: Enterprise customer experience company Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it has raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round that doubles the company’s valuation to $30 billion.

The new round was led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from existing investors who have led previous rounds, including Benchmark, Sequoia, Greenoaks, GV, and Tiger Global.
Sierra said that it currently serves almost 50% of Fortune 50 companies, and its clients include BNY, HSBC, Singtel, Wells Fargo, JPMorganChase, Pearson, Next, and Cox Automotive.
